INSTITUTE_INFO.venue: Main Campus Auditorium, NIT Patna (Ashok Rajpath)
INSTITUTE_INFO.venueDetails: NIT Patna, Mahendru, Ashok Rajpath, Patna – 800 005 (Bihar)
INSTITUTE_INFO.bihtaCampus: Bihta Campus (125 Acres), Dedicated to the Nation by Hon’ble PM Narendra Modi

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Arrival & Reporting at Venue
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Graduating students and invited guests arrive at Main Campus for verification and robing.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Mandatory Full Dress Rehearsal
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Full ceremonial rehearsal with Director, Deans, Senate members, and all degree recipients.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Robing & Lunch Reception
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Collection of ceremonial convocation stoles and lunch in the guest dining enclosure.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Academic Procession Enters Hall
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Formal academic procession of Senate Members, Board of Governors, Director, and Hon’ble Chief Guest.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Lighting of Lamp & Saraswati Vandana
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Traditional lamp lighting ceremony by Dignitaries on Dais followed by Saraswati Vandana.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Declaration of Opening of Convocation
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Convocation is officially declared “Open” by Chairperson, BOG, NIT Patna.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Keynote Address by Hon’ble Chief Guest
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Convocation Keynote Address to the XV graduating batch of NIT Patna.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Award of Gold Medals & Certificates
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Presentation of President’s Gold Medals, Director’s Gold Medals, Endowment Medals, and Certificates.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Director’s Annual Report
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Presented by Director, NIT Patna, highlighting institutional growth and academic milestones.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Confirmation of Degrees & Solemn Pledge
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Confirmation of Degrees and administration of the solemn Convocation Pledge (दीक्षान्त प्रतिज्ञा).

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: Award of Degrees by Director
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: Conferral of Ph.D, M.Tech, M.Arch, MURP, B.Tech, and B.Arch degrees.

PROGRAMME_EVENTS.title: National Anthem & Closing Declaration
PROGRAMME_EVENTS.description: National Anthem followed by formal declaration of closing of Convocation.
